slides.title: Past perfect
slides.subtitle: The past before the past
goals: Show which past action happened first.
Use it with **when, before, after, by the time, already**.

slides.title: Form and use

head: Example
rows: When I arrived, the film **had started**.
I **hadn't seen** snow before that trip.

list: Earlier action → past perfect; later action → past simple.
When I got to the station, the train **had left**. (= it left first)
When I got to the station, the train **left**. (= it left as I arrived)

items.en: By the time we got there, everyone had gone home.
She was nervous because she had never flown before.
I didn't recognize him. He had changed a lot.

items.q: When I got home, my brother ___ all the pizza.
I ___ the movie because I'd read the book.
She ___ her keys, so she couldn't get in.

items.t: We were late. The meeting ___ (already / start).
I ___ (not / finish) my homework when the teacher asked for it.
